rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a full/early-full blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a single static image, but relies heavily on the provided Gardner 2AA grade and adds tentative image details (e.g., ICM location/organization) without discussing zona features or day-4/full-blast inconsistency in depth.

Integrates age, BMI, AMH/FSH, unexplained infertility, first cycle, sperm parameters, endometrium, and oocyte yield into prognosis well, though some interactions could be more nuanced and it slightly overstates reassurance from ovarian markers.

Reasoning is mostly logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor issues include some hedging/inconsistency around day-4 blast timing and endometrial thickness interpretation.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based: supports single embryo transfer, standard luteal support, avoids unsupported add-ons, and cautions against overinterpreting one failed transfer. Small deviations include somewhat casual handling of a thick endometrium and day-4 blastocyst framing.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and reasonable future-cycle planning, including SET, luteal support, avoiding bed rest/add-ons, and review steps after failure; useful though not highly tailored to protocol specifics.
